book.title: Pwoo ɗinshee ɗi Pool ran Nen Koronti mo

content: Mat Mo Paakáa Fura Pee Seyil nNaan
Wu mwaan ndǝǝn shiimwaan fen, kaaɗi wen kǝn mwaan ndǝǝn shiimwaan mǝ Kristi sǝ.
Wen kwoop wun, mɓeɗǝ wuu pan an ndǝǝn mbii mo jir, kǝ wuu mwaan ndǝǝn kám dǝ wen kám mo nwun zak.
Amma wen rǝɓet kǝ wun man nǝ, a Kristi wu a káa kǝ koo a mish ɗeɗangyi, kǝ a mish wu a káa kǝ mat fin, kǝ Naan wu a káa kǝ Kristi.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ koo mish ɗeɗangyi ɗi wu cìn ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan), kǝ satpwoo Naan ndǝǝn ɗuu kǝ gurum mo kǝ káa fin a pǝpaa, ɓe wur jì kǝ yitluwaan nkaa Kristi ɗi a wu a káa fin mmǝnǝ.

Koo mat ɗeɗangyi ɗi war cìn ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan), kǝ satpwoo kǝ Naan ɗi baa war Paakáa war kas, ɓe war jì kǝ yitluwaan nkaa mish war. Ɗewur a káa fin, kǝzak, ɓe war ɗee a kaa mat ɗi mo sak káa nwar ngau sǝ mmǝnǝ.
Katɗang baa mat Paakáa fin kas, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ war saa shweepkáa fer. Amma katɗang saa shweepkáa koo sak shweepkáa nǝn njì kǝ yitluwaan mmat, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ war Paakáa fer.
Baa nǝ ret kǝ ngumish Paakáa fin kas, mɓeɗǝ Naan ɗak mish a kaa shin sǝ, kǝ wur kám a ɗeɗes kǝ Naan. Amma mat war kǝ kám a ɗeɗes mǝ mish.
Baa gyet Naan ɗak mish a shi fwoshik mǝ mat kas, ɗangbe gyet wur ɗak mat a fwoshik mǝ mish.
Kǝzak, baa gyet Naan wu le mish a mɓe mat kas, amma gyet wur le mat a mɓe mish.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ mat Paakáa war, kǝ nǝ kám ɗi nǝ, war nder kǝ mish fer, kǝ mɓe nenlep kǝ Naan mo zak.
Jir kǝsǝ, ɓe seen fun ɗi mun kǝ nǝ ndǝǝn Daa, ɓe baa mat war ɗyik kǝ mish fer kas, kǝ baa mish wur ɗik kǝ mat fin kas zak.
Mɓeɗi gyet Naan wu ɗak mat a shi mee ɗyes kǝ mish, kǝ nǝ aasǝ zak, yaksǝ ɓe a mat war kǝ làa mish. Mbii moo pwat a pee Naan ɗi jir.
Wun shikáa fuu, wu ɓeetpwoo ɗesǝ nǝ, kyet nǝn ndere mbǝkǝ mat war cìn ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan) nNaan ndǝǝn kuur kǝ gurum mo, ɗe baa war Paakáa war kas wo?
Koo a shi ɗyen, ɓe nǝ kám nwun kas aa? Nǝ a mbii yitluwaan kǝ mish wur ɗyel shweepkáa shwal-shwal.
Amma katɗang ɓe mat war ɗyel sheepkáa ɗeshwal-shwal, ɓe mǝnǝ a mbii jwat nwar kas aa? Mɓǝɗǝ mo shin sheepkáa ɗeshwal-shwal nǝ nwar, a mbǝkǝ waa Paakáa war ɗi.
Amma katɗang mee ngwar kǝ rǝɓet ɓeetshik nkaa pwoo ɗesǝ, ɓe baa mumun, koo Ekǝlisya mǝ Naan mo, baa mu loot kǝ mee ar ɗi nǝ a mǝ seyil nNaan ɗi nǝ ɗik kǝ mǝnǝ kas.
Tǝkook Kǝ Se Tong Ashak

nƊǝǝn wàar ɗǝsǝ, ɓe baa wen kwoop wun kas, mɓeɗǝ kuur fuu nǝ baa nii kwoop nǝ kas. Mɓeɗi katɗang wu jì wu kaat ndǝǝn kuur fuu, ɓe mbii ɗi wuu cìn nǝ mo, ɓe baa mo ret kas. Nii waa wuwat gurum mo met aku ɗi nǝn mɓam mo.
To, ɗinshee nǝ, katɗang wu kuur, kaa Ekǝlisya sǝ, mɓe seyil nNaan, ɓe baa pwoo fuu moo dǝm ndangshak kas, har kaaɗe ɗe wen kǝlǝng pwoo mǝnǝ, ɓe wen ɗoom shinzeen nǝ.
Baa nǝ kǝ mee kyetwoo kas, nǝ a tǝng, kǝ mo kat ɓàkshak ɗi ndǝǝn wun, mbǝkǝ mo man nen dǝm ndang Naan ɗe ɗǝre nǝ mo ɗi azeen-nzeen.
Katɗang wu jì wu kaat ashak, ɓe baa wuu se a Tong Ashak mǝ Daa nǝ kas.
Mɓǝɗǝ katɗang wu ɗoom se nǝ, ɓe koo weye wur yaa se mbiise ɗi wur jì kǝni, har wuu le kǝ neenláa mpak mo, kǝ pak moo shwaa ɓe yiirkaa ɗi.

Kai! Baa wun kǝ tul ɗi wun nse kǝ shwaa ɗi kas aa? A me le ɗang wuu toklong shi nkuur mǝ Ekǝlisya kǝ Daa ye? Kǝ a me le ɗang wuu shin yitluwaan nen ɗi baa mo kǝ mee mbii kas yi? Wen nsat a me nwun mbǝ mbii kaa ɗesǝ sǝ yi? Wen nkwoop wun aa? Hai yo, baa wen nkwoop wun kas koo dǝɓen.
Ar Se Tong AshakMǝ Daa, Ɗǝ Nǝ Ret
Wen lap kám ɗǝsǝ nǝ a pee Daa ɗǝ, ɗe wen kǝn shin nwun sǝ zak. Nǝ, mpar ɗi gyet mo seet Daa Jesu ɗi, ɓe Daa Jesu wur mang gill aas.

Aɓwoon ɗi wur kǝ cìn ɗangnaan (leshap kǝ Naan) mǝ pǝlang Naan nkaa gill aas nǝ, ɓe wur yilang nǝ, wur sat nǝnee, <<Ɗesǝ nǝ a fwoshik fen, <<ɗi wen kǝn shin nǝ mɓe wun, <<Wu naa nshìn aasǝ, <<mbǝkǝ taji wu muunshik nwen kas.>>

Nǝ aasǝ zak, ɓe aɓwoon ɗi mo se mbiise, ɓe wur mang laaɗaa, ɓe wu sat nǝnee, <<Laaɗaa ɗǝsǝ nǝ a ɓǝlemcuk shi toom kǝ Naan ɗepwoo, ɗi nǝ ndǝǝn toom fen. Katɗang koo a pǝrangye ɗi wun nshwaa am anab ndǝǝn laaɗaa nǝ, ɓe wuu shwaa nǝ a mbǝkǝ taji wu muunshik wen kas.>>
Shii kǝ ɗǝsǝ nǝ a nǝ, koo a pǝrangye ɗi wuu se gill aas nǝ, kǝ wu shwaa am anab ndǝǝn laaɗaa nǝ, ɓe wuu cìn a langtǝng nkaa muut kǝ Daa Jesu, har parɗi wur mbaa jì.
Se Tong AshakMǝ Daa nDǝǝn ar Ɗebish
Katɗang mee gwe kǝ se gill aas nǝ kǝ shwaa am anab ndǝǝn laaɗaa mǝ Daa nǝ, baa a ndǝǝn ar ɗin ɗǝre kas, ɓe gwe mǝnǝ kǝ cìn a shikbish nkaa fwoshik mǝ Jesu kǝ toom fir mmǝnǝ.
Nǝ ret kǝ gurum shee kyamshin fin akuɗang wur se gill aas, kǝ shwaa am anab ɗi nǝn ndǝǝn laaɗaa mǝ Daa nǝ.
Mɓǝɗǝ katɗang baa gurum manshii kǝ shin mǝ Daa Jesu kǝ toom fin nǝ kas, ɗangɓe wu kǝ se gill aas kǝ shwaa am anab ɗi nǝ ndǝǝn laaɗaa mǝ Daa ni, ɓe gwar mǝnǝ kǝ jì aa ɗyeel nkaa fwoshik fin mmǝnǝ.
A nii le, ɗangɓe pak fuu mo a gok, kǝ baa pak mo kǝ ɓal kas, har pak fuu mo ɗes, mo kǝ murǝp.
Amma katɗang mǝ kyamsun fun mo azeen-nzeen, kǝ mǝ cìn mbii mon ndǝre-ndǝre ɓe baa Naan tokɗyeel mmun kas.
Amma Naan wur tokɗyeel mmun, kǝ wur kar mun, a mbǝkǝ taji wu ncanɗyeel ɗebish mmun ashak kǝ gurum ɗebish, ɗi mo ndǝǝn yil ɗesǝ, parkyes kǝ yil nǝ kas.
Mɓǝmǝnǝ, ɗyemnaa mo, katɗang wu kuur ashak mɓe Se Tong Ashak mǝ Daa, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ wu ɗarnaa shak.

Katɗang neenláa mmemee fuu, ɓe nǝ ret kǝ gwar mǝnǝ sese ntul fir akuɗang wur jì kuur nǝ. Mbeekǝ taji Naan wur canɗyeel ɗebish nkaa wun jir, a peekuur fuu nǝ. Pwoo nkaa koor mbii ɗi mo ɗee ɗi, ɓe see parɗǝ wen wul pee wun ɗi, ɗangɓe wen nsatpwoo nwun nkaa mo jir.
